description:
find conformance: GNU findutils 4.10 in the oracle is the reference for status, stdout and stderr.

`-newerXt` dates go through uutils' `parse_datetime`, so GNU's grammar (relative dates, month
names, compact dates, offsets, `@EPOCH`) is compared here too.

GNU walks directories in readdir order, so every case listing more than one sibling sorts its output.

cases.name: find: whole tree
find: name glob
find: iname
find: name bracket and escape
find: type f and d
find: type list
find: depth limits
find: maxdepth zero with several starts
find: default start
find: trailing slash start
find: path glob
find: ipath and wholename
find: or with parentheses
find: negation
find: and binds tighter than or
find: explicit and
find: comma operator
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/f/src/lib /tmp/f/docs /tmp/f/empty && cd /tmp/f && printf 'fn main() {}
' > src/main.rs && printf 'pub fn x() {}
' > src/lib/mod.rs && : > src/blank.txt && printf '# Title
' > docs/README.md && printf 'notes
' > docs/notes.txt && printf '%1500s' x > big.bin && printf 'upper
' > Upper.TXT; find . -maxdepth 1 -name src -printf 'A %p
' , -name docs -printf 'B %p
' | sort

cases.name: find: true and false
find: prune
find: prune is ignored with depth
find: preorder
cases.script: mkdir -p /tmp/d/a/b/c && : > /tmp/d/a/b/c/leaf; find /tmp/d

cases.name: find: depth order
cases.script: mkdir -p /tmp/d/a/b/c && : > /tmp/d/a/b/c/leaf; find /tmp/d -depth; find /tmp/d -d -mindepth 2

cases.name: find: quit
cases.script: mkdir -p /tmp/d/a/b/c && : > /tmp/d/a/b/c/leaf; find /tmp/d -name b -print -quit; find /tmp/d -quit; echo status=$?

cases.name: find: empty
find: size units round up
find: size below one unit
find: newer
cases.script: mkdir -p /tmp/age && cd /tmp/age && touch -d '2020-01-01 00:00:00' old && touch -d '2021-06-01 12:00:00' mid && touch -d '5 minutes ago' new; find . -type f -newer mid | sort; find . -type f -newer old | sort

cases.name: find: mtime and mmin
cases.script: mkdir -p /tmp/age && cd /tmp/age && touch -d '2020-01-01 00:00:00' old && touch -d '2021-06-01 12:00:00' mid && touch -d '5 minutes ago' new; find . -type f -mtime +30 | sort; find . -type f -mtime -1; find . -type f -mmin -60; find . -type f -mtime 0

cases.name: find: newermt
cases.script: mkdir -p /tmp/age && cd /tmp/age && touch -d '2020-01-01 00:00:00' old && touch -d '2021-06-01 12:00:00' mid && touch -d '5 minutes ago' new; find . -type f -newermt '2020-06-01' | sort; find . -type f ! -newermt '2021-06-01 12:00:01' | sort

cases.name: find: newermt relative dates
cases.script: mkdir -p /tmp/age && cd /tmp/age && touch -d '2020-01-01 00:00:00' old && touch -d '2021-06-01 12:00:00' mid && touch -d '5 minutes ago' new; find . -type f -newermt yesterday; find . -type f -newermt '1 year ago'; find . -type f -newermt now; find . -type f -newermt 'next monday'; echo end

cases.name: find: newermt other date forms
cases.script: mkdir -p /tmp/age && cd /tmp/age && touch -d '2020-01-01 00:00:00' old && touch -d '2021-06-01 12:00:00' mid && touch -d '5 minutes ago' new; find . -type f -newermt 'Jun 1 2020' | sort; find . -type f -newermt 20200601 | sort; find . -type f -newermt '2020-06-01 12:00:00 +0200' | sort; find . -type f -newermt @1590969600 | sort

cases.name: find: newermt unreadable date
cases.script: find . -newermt xyz; echo status=$?

cases.name: find: regex default dialect
find: regex literal operators
find: regextype posix-extended
find: iregex
find: print0
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/f/src/lib /tmp/f/docs /tmp/f/empty && cd /tmp/f && printf 'fn main() {}
' > src/main.rs && printf 'pub fn x() {}
' > src/lib/mod.rs && : > src/blank.txt && printf '# Title
' > docs/README.md && printf 'notes
' > docs/notes.txt && printf '%1500s' x > big.bin && printf 'upper
' > Upper.TXT; find . -name '*.rs' -print0 | sort -z | tr '\0' '
'

cases.name: find: printf path directives
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/f/src/lib /tmp/f/docs /tmp/f/empty && cd /tmp/f && printf 'fn main() {}
' > src/main.rs && printf 'pub fn x() {}
' > src/lib/mod.rs && : > src/blank.txt && printf '# Title
' > docs/README.md && printf 'notes
' > docs/notes.txt && printf '%1500s' x > big.bin && printf 'upper
' > Upper.TXT; find . -maxdepth 1 -printf '%p|%f|%h|%P|%H|%d|%y
' | sort; find src/ -maxdepth 0 -printf '%p|%f|%P
'

cases.name: find: printf widths
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/f/src/lib /tmp/f/docs /tmp/f/empty && cd /tmp/f && printf 'fn main() {}
' > src/main.rs && printf 'pub fn x() {}
' > src/lib/mod.rs && : > src/blank.txt && printf '# Title
' > docs/README.md && printf 'notes
' > docs/notes.txt && printf '%1500s' x > big.bin && printf 'upper
' > Upper.TXT; find . -type f -printf '[%5s] [%-10f] [%.3f]
' | sort

cases.name: find: printf time
cases.script: mkdir -p /tmp/s && touch -d '2020-03-04 05:06:07' /tmp/s/stamp; find /tmp/s/stamp -printf '%t|%TY-%Tm-%Td %TH:%TM:%TS|%T@|%Tc|%TD|%Tj|%Ta %Tb %Te|%Ts|%T+\n'

cases.name: find: printf escapes
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/f/src/lib /tmp/f/docs /tmp/f/empty && cd /tmp/f && printf 'fn main() {}
' > src/main.rs && printf 'pub fn x() {}
' > src/lib/mod.rs && : > src/blank.txt && printf '# Title
' > docs/README.md && printf 'notes
' > docs/notes.txt && printf '%1500s' x > big.bin && printf 'upper
' > Upper.TXT; find . -maxdepth 0 -printf 'a	b\\101
'; find . -maxdepth 0 -printf 'x\cy
'; echo

cases.name: find: printf unknown directive warns
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/f/src/lib /tmp/f/docs /tmp/f/empty && cd /tmp/f && printf 'fn main() {}
' > src/main.rs && printf 'pub fn x() {}
' > src/lib/mod.rs && : > src/blank.txt && printf '# Title
' > docs/README.md && printf 'notes
' > docs/notes.txt && printf '%1500s' x > big.bin && printf 'upper
' > Upper.TXT; find . -maxdepth 0 -printf '%z|\q
'; echo status=$?

cases.name: find: printf percent at end
find: fprint
find: exec per file
find: exec batch
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/f/src/lib /tmp/f/docs /tmp/f/empty && cd /tmp/f && printf 'fn main() {}
' > src/main.rs && printf 'pub fn x() {}
' > src/lib/mod.rs && : > src/blank.txt && printf '# Title
' > docs/README.md && printf 'notes
' > docs/notes.txt && printf '%1500s' x > big.bin && printf 'upper
' > Upper.TXT; find src -name '*.rs' -exec echo {} + | tr ' ' '
' | sort

cases.name: find: exec status is the test
find: exec substitutes inside words
find: exec awkward names
cases.script: mkdir -p /tmp/q && : > '/tmp/q/a b' && : > "/tmp/q/it's" && : > '/tmp/q/$x'; find /tmp/q -type f -exec echo {} \; | sort

cases.name: find: execdir
find: exec command not found
find: exec failure in batch
find: delete
find: delete nonempty directory
find: missing start point
find: unknown predicate
cases.script: find . -foo; echo status=$?

cases.name: find: paths must precede expression
cases.script: find -type f /tmp; echo status=$?; find -print /tmp; echo status=$?

cases.name: find: missing argument
cases.script: find . -name; echo status=$?; find . -exec echo; echo status=$?

cases.name: find: operator errors
cases.script: find . -o; echo $?; find . -name x -o; echo $?; find . !; echo $?; find . \( \); echo $?; find . -name x \); echo $?; find . \( -name x; echo $?

cases.name: find: type errors
cases.script: find . -type x; echo $?; find . -type ff; echo $?; find . -type f,; echo $?

cases.name: find: numeric argument errors
cases.script: find . -size 1q; echo $?; find . -mtime x; echo $?; find . -maxdepth -1; echo $?

cases.name: find: regex errors
cases.script: find . -regex 'a\(b'; echo $?; find . -regextype nope -regex x; echo $?

cases.name: find: exec plus errors
cases.script: find . -exec echo {} {} +; echo $?; find . -exec echo {}x +; echo $?

cases.name: find: delete with prune
cases.script: find . -name x -prune -o -delete; echo $?

cases.name: find: head of a large tree
cases.script: mkdir -p /tmp/big && for i in {1..300}; do : > /tmp/big/f$i; done; find /tmp/big -type f | head -n 1 | wc -l; find /tmp/big | head -n 3 | wc -l

cases.name: find: refuses perm

expected.reason: WASI has no permission bits or owners, so these predicates are refused

cases.name: find: refuses owner printf
cases.script:
mkdir -p /tmp/f/src/lib /tmp/f/docs /tmp/f/empty && cd /tmp/f && printf 'fn main() {}
' > src/main.rs && printf 'pub fn x() {}
' > src/lib/mod.rs && : > src/blank.txt && printf '# Title
' > docs/README.md && printf 'notes
' > docs/notes.txt && printf '%1500s' x > big.bin && printf 'upper
' > Upper.TXT; find . -printf '%u
'; echo status=$?

expected.reason: WASI has no permission bits or owners, so these predicates are refused
